old_policy_position: nuclear favored subject to safety, finance, fuel, workforce, liability, upstream, climate and geopolitical gates
new_policy_position: nuclear favored only where cyber/digital/AI/OT/software/vendor/grid-telecom/security-publication gates are also satisfied
rationale: Clean firm value cannot be credited if digital dependencies can compromise safety, reliability, emergency preparedness or public trust.

old_policy_position: general security-sensitive publication controls existed for nuclear tables
new_policy_position: cyber-specific controls separate public assurance from network/vulnerability/vendor-access/incident details
rationale: Cyber assurance must be publicly challengeable without publishing attack-enabling details.
